priority: Defense first, per explicit user authorization on 2026-10-16. Temporary team scoring regression is permitted for research; team and individual scoring errors remain reported. This does not authorize unverified adoption.
baseline: Frozen v42 defender-dependent recorded shot selection and v41 make defense
diagnostic: Separate raw fresh-FGA on/off, fitted source-conditional make expectations, whole-game heldout expectations, runtime transfer and rotation effects before changing defense strength. No player-name adjustment, rank target, or simulation on/off residual fitting.

makeDefenseCandidates.selection: Per-zone minimum whole-game five-fold heldout NLL on older three seasons, target excluded. Sigma zero has only Gaussian family.

acceptance: Report broad player defensive accuracy, shot selection and make rates, individual box scores and team errors. Temporary team PPG regression alone no longer rejects a research candidate. Preserve prior frozen protocols and outputs.
